findings.body: Containing the conversation ID does not establish that an InvalidRequestError means the conversation is absent. The pinned server also includes that ID when history cannot be materialized for includeTurns. This handler converts that failed read into null, causing recover() to log "lost" and permit another turn. Match only confirmed missing-conversation errors; propagate other failures so recovery refuses. Add a stub case for a non-missing InvalidRequestError containing the ID. See the pinned server's [history-read error mapping](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.156.1/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs#L5631).
findings.title: Not done: 9. Distinguish missing conversations from failed history reads

findings.body: Both approval comparisons are conditional on a truthy hash. If the approval or its state file is removed after a task starts, an edited story passes both checks, records a status commit, and starts Codex without renewed approval. An earlier task-start approval does not authorize that changed brief. Refuse missing approval before comparing hashes, as src/forge/task.py:137–141 already does when starting a task.
